sections.title: Quick Answer
sections.content: **FaithWall** puts the Bible verse you choose on your iPhone lock screen as a wallpaper: search 1 Corinthians 16:13 or Ephesians 6:10, pick it, and the app applies it through an Apple Shortcut. For the look most men want, use a black background, one bold typeface and a verse of 15 words or fewer, like most of the twelve below.

sections.text: A good **Bible verse wallpaper for men** is less about the picture and more about the verse: a line on strength, courage or discipline that you can read in the second it takes to check the time. FaithWall does the setting, and this page helps with the choosing and the look. Below are 12 King James verses in four groups, each with its word count, plus the design choices that keep a dark screen readable. For the year-round picture, start with the [guide to daily Scripture on the lock screen](/daily-scripture-lock-screen).
How do you put a verse on your iPhone lock screen?

There are two ways. FaithWall finds the verse, lays it out for the lock screen and applies it as your wallpaper through an Apple Shortcut. The wallpaper maker on this site makes one image that you set yourself from the Photos app. Both keep the verse clear of the clock. The difference is who does the setting, and what happens when you want the next verse.

items: Download FaithWall.
Find your verse by reference or by search, in any of 24 translations. Every verse on this page is KJV.
Choose the wallpaper setup. Once you pick the verse, the app runs an Apple Shortcut that applies it, and iOS shows Shortcuts for a moment.
Want it darker or bolder? Change the background or text style, then tap Update Wallpaper Now in the app's Settings so the new style reaches the lock screen.
The verse stays until you pick another. When the season changes, choose the next one.

sections.content: **No-install option:** the free [Bible verse wallpaper maker](/bible-verse-wallpaper-maker) runs in your browser. Type the verse, pick a style and a size (1179 × 2556 pixels for recent standard iPhones, 1290 × 2796 for Pro Max and Plus models), download the PNG and set it as your wallpaper from Photos. It stays that one verse until you make another image.

sections.text: Comparing apps before you choose one? Here's our [ranking of Bible verse lock screen apps](/best-bible-verse-lock-screen-apps), with the trade-offs of each.
What design keeps a verse readable on a dark lock screen?

Dark backgrounds suit a men's verse wallpaper because the white clock and a white verse both stand out against them. Use one typeface, one colour for the verse and a short line of text. The rest is placement: the verse belongs in the band between the clock at the top and the flashlight and camera buttons at the bottom.

items: **Background:** pure black or a flat near-black. Mountains, wood grain and leather textures look strong in a gallery, but busy texture behind white text costs contrast at a glance.
**Type:** one bold sans-serif for a short verse, one serif for a longer one. Never mix the two on one screen.
**Length:** 15 words or fewer for bold type, which takes more room per word than a serif.
**Accent:** one colour, orange or gold, for the reference line only, so the verse itself stays white.
**Placement:** below the clock and widgets, above the bottom buttons, never centred on the whole screen.

sections.text: The maker on this site builds those choices in, so you can see them before you design anything. Its Pure black style is a #000000 background with a white, centred serif. Its Bold sans style is a near-black #0a0a0f background with white bold sans-serif type, left-aligned, and the reference in orange capitals. On phone sizes it keeps the verse below the top 35% of the image, where iOS draws the date, clock and widgets, and above the bottom 12%, where the two buttons sit. Those figures come from the maker's own layout code, read on November 18, 2026, and they are the same zones any **Bible verse wallpaper for men** has to respect.

sections.text: 12 Bible verses for men, grouped by what they ask of you

24% of U.S. men are active Bible users, per the American Bible Society's 2026 State of the Bible report, and a verse on the lock screen meets the rest of the week too. These 12 King James verses cover strength, courage, discipline and brotherhood. Each line gives the KJV text and its word count, counted on November 18, 2026 from the King James text this site serves. Our judgment: up to 15 words suits bold type, up to about 20 a serif, and anything longer needs small type.
Strength

items: Ephesians 6:10 — "Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might." (15 words)
Psalm 18:32 — "It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect." (13 words)
Philippians 4:13 — "I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me." (10 words)

sections.text: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.
Courage

items: 1 Corinthians 16:13 — "Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong." (13 words)
Proverbs 28:1 — "The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion." (15 words)
2 Timothy 1:7 — "For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind." (21 words)
Joshua 1:9 — "Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the Lord thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest." (30 words)

sections.text: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
Discipline and work

items: Proverbs 4:23 — "Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life." (15 words)
Colossians 3:23 — "And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;" (15 words)
2 Chronicles 15:7 — "Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded." (17 words)

sections.text: Brotherhood and leadership

items: Proverbs 27:17 — "Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend." (12 words)
Micah 6:8 — "He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the Lord require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?" (32 words)

sections.text: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

sections.content: **Long verses need a decision.** Joshua 1:9 runs 30 words and Micah 6:8 runs 32, so neither works in bold type. Set them in a serif at a smaller size, or choose a shorter verse from the same group. Isaiah 40:31, the eagles verse, runs 33 words, so it isn't on the list. Read it whole in Isaiah 40 instead.

sections.title: Designed for the surface
sections.content: A lock screen is not a page. The verse has to share the screen with the clock, the date and two buttons, and be read in a glance. The app lays out the verse you pick for exactly that space.

sections.text: Where this gets hard: a dark image isn't a lock screen

A black **Bible verse wallpaper for men** from a gallery looks clean as a thumbnail. On the phone, the clock lands on the first line, a widget covers the reference, or the crop cuts the last word, because most images are made for a feed, not for the lock-screen surface. And when you want a new verse, you're back to finding, saving and cropping another image.

**FaithWall takes the image work off your hands.** You pick the verse, the app lays it out under the clock and applies it, and it stays until you choose the next one. Pick one for the stretch you're in: Ephesians 6:10 for a hard season at work, Proverbs 27:17 for the friend you meet with each week. For more picks that fit a glance, see these [short Bible verses for the lock screen](/blog/short-bible-verses-for-lock-screen), and the [step-by-step lock screen setup guide](/blog/bible-verse-lock-screen-iphone) covers the wallpaper and the widget in detail.

1 Corinthians 16:13 was written to a whole church. "Quit you like men" is older English for "act like men", and it sits between "stand fast in the faith" and "be strong". The next verse finishes the thought: "Let all your things be done with charity." Strength, in Paul's letter, comes with that.
